capabilities: Build a sampled similarity map of related papers from a title, DOI, or OpenAlex ID
Inspect shared references, co-citations, and direct citation evidence for map nodes and edges
Save papers and projects and track their reading status
Write literature notes and synchronize reading status with linked notes
Export papers as BibTeX, YAML, and Markdown and embed the graph in notes
disambiguation: Not affiliated with the Connected Papers web app despite the similar name; it queries OpenAlex and other scholarly APIs directly.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian 1.14.4+); mobile awaits testing. Service credentials are stored unencrypted in data.json. An optional AI research narrative is off by default. AGPL-3.0 license; no telemetry. The map is a sample, not a complete citation index.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to discover related scholarly papers, inspect the citation evidence behind a relationship, or track reading status for a literature workflow.

relations.evidence: The plugin may retrieve additional abstracts and reference data from OpenAlex, Semantic Scholar, or Crossref
